oneTimers: Arm recorded a $39M gain from equity investments in the quarter, which it strips out of its non-GAAP results: excluding it (and share-based pay), non-GAAP net income was $417M versus $252M GAAP.
otherDetail: Combined other items added $93M to profit: a $39M gain from equity investments, $28M of net interest income and $26M of other non-operating income. Tax was just a $16M expense — a 6.0% effective rate — versus 40.4% a year ago.
pngFooterNote: Record revenue and royalties; net income nearly tripled.

segments.name: License and other revenue
segments.note: Fees for licensing Arm chip designs, plus support and related services; up 14% YoY on the timing and size of high-value license agreements and contributions from backlog.

segments.name: Royalty revenue
segments.note: A cut of every chip shipped with Arm technology inside; up 23% YoY on wider use of the Armv9 architecture, the ramp of chips based on Arm CSS (ready-made compute subsystems), IoT improvement, and more Arm-based chips in data centers.

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 19% to a record $983M, above the high end of guidance, on record royalty revenue and better-than-expected licensing. License revenue rose 14% to $403M and royalty revenue rose 23% to a record $580M. For the first nine months of the fiscal year, revenue was $2,766M, up 20% year over year.
takeaways.title: Record revenue on record royalties

takeaways.text: Royalty revenue grew 23% to $580M on wider use of the Armv9 architecture, the ramp of Arm CSS ready-made compute subsystems, IoT improvement, and more Arm-based chips in data centers. CSS is now shipping in volume and materially contributing to royalty growth. AWS said more than 50% of new CPU capacity installed over the past two years was on Graviton, and over 90% of its top 1,000 EC2 customers use Graviton.
takeaways.title: Royalties keep climbing on Armv9 and CSS

takeaways.text: GAAP net income nearly tripled to $252M, up 190% from $87M a year ago, or $0.24 per share versus $0.08. Operating income was $175M, up 31%, even with record R&D investment of $533M. A $39M gain on equity investments and $26M of other non-operating income helped, and tax was just 6.0%. Excluding the equity gain and share-based pay, non-GAAP net income was $417M, or $0.39 per share.
takeaways.title: Net income nearly tripled

verdict: Arm's revenue rose 19% to a record $983M on record royalty revenue of $580M, and GAAP net income nearly tripled to $252M as a $39M gain on equity investments and a low 6.0% tax rate lifted the bottom line.
